title: System Bot and Project Manager
description: System Bot delegates the run to Project Manager. Project Manager reports plan readiness, the five Foreman worker pools, verification, and final handoff back to System Bot.

messages.text: Hi Project Manager, the user has submitted a build request. I am assigning you as supervisor to coordinate the full build process.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: System Bot creates a Project Manager channel for this build request.

messages.text: Understood. I will start the build process. Since I only have the image path for now, I need to request a blueprint from Designer first.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Project Manager opens the Designer channel to request image-to-blueprint conversion.

messages.text: Designer returned placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, and uncertainty notes. I am planning five Foreman packets: A through E.
Foreman dispatch is ready: Foreman-A through Foreman-E, five worker-pool rooms, and 100 total workers. Each pool will report aggregate progress and exceptions only.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.open: Project Manager prepares the Foreman council and five worker-pool rooms.

messages.text: Shared skill scheduling is active: Place, Remove, and Replace are learned inside worker-pool rooms, then exposed through the global Skill Library for other pools to reuse.
Final audit passed. The world diff matches the blueprint after approved fixes, and no temporary tags remain in the exported schematic.
Returning final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, logs/*.log, and the original input metadata to System Bot for the user-facing completion message.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: channel.close: Project Manager returns the final package metadata to System Bot.
